phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / Phase B — F3 materialization
purpose: Retain one immutable ECB QSA source vintage and populate only the F3 stock and transaction matrices from direct observations or exact sector identities already verified in Phase A.

classification.OBSERVED: Cell value comes from one exact canonical ECB QSA series at the required boundary and period.
classification.DERIVED: Cell value is produced only by exact additive sector identities required to map QSA S12 to RMD F = S12 minus S121.
classification.NOT_APPLICABLE: The X→X position lies outside the Romanian national financial-accounts boundary and is excluded structurally rather than set to an observed zero.

rounding.benchmark_value: Use OBS_VALUE rounded to the official ECB DECIMALS attribute.
rounding.raw_value: Retain the raw API OBS_VALUE in the immutable source vintage.
rounding.reason: Avoid storing binary transport representation as more precise than the published statistical observation.

required_offline_checks: all 35 in-boundary F3 stock cells have a finite observed or exact-derived value
all 35 in-boundary F3 flow cells have a finite observed or exact-derived value
X→X stock and flow are NOT_APPLICABLE rather than zero
F3 stock row sums reconcile to published QSA total assets for H/C/F/G/BNR
F3 stock column sums reconcile to published QSA total liabilities for H/C/F/G/BNR
F3 flow row sums reconcile to published QSA total transactions in assets for H/C/F/G/BNR
F3 flow column sums reconcile to published QSA total transactions in liabilities for H/C/F/G/BNR
X→G total maturity reconciles to short plus long maturity for stock and flow
external-holder F3 stock row reproduces 493246.93 million RON control
regenerating F3 benchmark from the retained source vintage produces no semantic diff
promotion_rule: Only F3 may change from TBD/SOURCE_SERIES_IDENTIFIED to OBSERVED, DERIVED or NOT_APPLICABLE in this phase. All other instruments and scientific mechanism statuses remain unchanged.
